bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
client="$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 71
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 72
rows=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%✅ 終了%' THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%🔴 LIVE中%' THEN 'LIVE' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND r.status='finished' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id") || exit 73
test -n "$rows" || exit 74
i=0
failed=0
while IFS='|' read -r chat mid dbmark; do
 i=$((i+1))
 echo PUBLIC_CARD_ORDINAL="$i"
 echo DB_MARKER="$dbmark"
 if "$py" -B "$client" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$mid"; then echo PUBLIC_CARD_READBACK=PASS; else failed=$((failed+1));echo PUBLIC_CARD_READBACK=NOT_VERIFIED; fi
done <<EOF
$rows
EOF
echo PUBLIC_CARD_COUNT="$i"
echo PUBLIC_CARD_UNVERIFIED="$failed"
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 76
test "$failed" = 0 || exit 77
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_REAL_READBACK_PASS
